title: Perfect internal Hom quasi-coherence
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and K,L objects of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume L has quasi-coherent cohomology. If K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then RSheafHom(K,L) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] has quasi-coherent cohomology, with no boundedness assumption on L.

proof.text: On each neighbourhood with a strictly perfect model for K, its cohomology is quasi-coherent: finite-free sheaves are quasi-coherent, direct summands remain quasi-coherent, and kernels and cokernels of maps of quasi-coherent modules on schemes remain quasi-coherent. Thus K belongs to the quasi-coherent derived subcategory. The perfect tensor-Hom comparison gives a quasi-coherent perfect dual D and an isomorphism RHom(K,L) with L tensor^L D. Choose K-flat representatives to compute this tensor. Preservation of quasi-coherence under derived tensor gives quasi-coherent cohomology of L tensor^L D, and the comparison isomorphism transports it to RHom(K,L). The argument imposes no boundedness condition on L.
